recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-26068; if GraphDefinition wording is revisited later, it should be handled in HL7/api-incubator-ig, but this specific definition is already correct there.

initial_application: Core commit 2ff4cda4a3af626ee2a45d7c353410ea0eec85da applied the Jira request by changing source/graphdefinition/structuredefinition-GraphDefinition.xml from "A FHIR expression that identifies one of FHIR References to other resources." to "A FHIRPath expression that identifies one of FHIR References to other resources." No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-26068 was present on the combined branch.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-06-29 record the motion passing for FHIR-26068. Current R6 core no longer has GraphDefinition as an active fhir.ini resource, and source/conformance-module.html points GraphDefinition to the API Incubator. Commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd intentionally deleted source/graphdefinition and removed graphdefinition from source/fhir.ini. The current HL7/api-incubator-ig source for StructureDefinition-GraphDefinition already defines GraphDefinition.link.path as a FHIRPath expression.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. An empty external-repo audit commit was published because the authoritative current GraphDefinition source is outside this FHIR core checkout, and that external source already carries the requested wording.
